note: Network-definition sources read for Phase 4D.4H-A design decisions. Commits are the Phase 4D.4A audit pins (research/alphazero_baseline/external_review.json); AlphaZero.jl is pinned here for the first time at its master head. Files were read as evidence only: no external code, weights or performance claim was adopted.

sources.architecture: Stem conv3x3-BN-ReLU; blocks conv-BN-ReLU-conv-BN, skip, ReLU; convolutions keep their default bias. Connect Four: 5 blocks x 128 filters, 32 policy-head and 32 value-head 1x1 filters, value hidden width = num_filters, batch-norm momentum 0.1 (library default 0.6). L2 1e-4 applies to Dense and Conv weights only; Adam lr 2e-3.

3 input planes; bias-free conv3x3-BN-ReLU stem; 5 x 128 post-activation blocks; 32-filter 1x1 policy and value heads, value hidden 256; raw logits and tanh (N,1) value. Adam with weight decay on every parameter.

2 input planes; bias-free stem; 5 x 64 post-activation blocks; AlphaGo-Zero-style narrow heads (2 policy filters, 1 value filter, value hidden 64). The source comments put the network at about 375k-400k parameters and argue self-play throughput, not capacity, is the laptop bottleneck.

3 input planes; bias-free stem; default 6 x 96 post-activation blocks with a 3 x 64 smoke preset; 32-filter 1x1 policy and value heads, value hidden 64. AdamW lr 1e-3 with weight decay 1e-4 on every parameter.
3 input planes; biased stem; 19 x 128 post-activation blocks; 32-filter policy head returning probabilities, 3-filter value head with hidden 32.

references: Silver et al., Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge, Nature 550 (2017), Methods: Neural network architecture
Silver et al., A general reinforcement learning algorithm that masters chess, shogi and Go through self-play, Science 362 (2018)
original_alphazero.architecture: Stem conv3x3 (256 filters)-BN-ReLU; 19 or 39 residual blocks (AlphaGo Zero) / 19 (AlphaZero) of conv3x3-BN-ReLU-conv3x3-BN, skip, ReLU; policy head 1x1 conv (2 filters)-BN-ReLU-linear; value head 1x1 conv (1 filter)-BN-ReLU-linear 256-ReLU-linear 1-tanh; L2 1e-4; SGD with momentum.
original_alphazero.status: Summarized from the published papers, not fetched or hashed in this phase.
